options.name: authPassword
options.description: Auth password for SNMPv3. Required if snmpMode is 'AUTHPRIV' or 'AUTHNOPRIV'. Use 'NO!$DATA!$' if no change required.

options.name: authType
options.description: SNMPv3 auth protocol. 'SHA' or 'MD5'. Required if snmpMode is 'AUTHPRIV' or 'AUTHNOPRIV'.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments to identify the SNMPv3 credential.

options.name: credentialType
options.description: Credential type to identify the application that uses the SNMPv3 credential.

options.name: description
options.description: Description for SNMPv3 Credential.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center hostname.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center port.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id of the SNMPv3 Credential.

options.name: instanceTenantId
options.description: Deprecated. This attribute will be removed in a future release, should not be used, and any value supplied will be ignored.

options.name: instanceUuid
options.description: Deprecated. This attribute will be removed in a future release, should not be used, and any value supplied will be ignored.

options.name: privacyPassword
options.description: Privacy password for SNMPv3 privacy. Required if snmpMode is 'AUTHPRIV'. Use 'NO!$DATA!$' if no change required.

options.name: privacyType
options.description: SNMPv3 privacy protocol. Required is snmpMode is 'AUTHPRIV'.

options.name: snmpMode
options.description: Mode of SNMPv3. 'AUTHPRIV' or 'AUTHNOPRIV' or 'NOAUTHNOPRIV'.

options.name: username
options.description: SNMPv3 username.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
